title: Plant-suitability serving plane — the frozen v0 prototype taken to a production GIS plane
description: One Parquet row per 0.01 deg cell of WA/OR/ID with three guilds of candidates (greenstrip, post-fire restoration, woody buffer / hedgerow; never a fire claim), consuming the committed soil-properties lane, new climate-normal lanes (USDA PHZM 2023; a regional frost-free bias surface; precipitation only after D-PRISM), a governed region-scale curation dataset, one static plant-reference release set, and a live-DuckDB full-list agent tool behind verified access; validated by independent recompute, transcription review, a rule-derived watch list, LANDFIRE EVT and later community observations.
review_state: Critic pass 1 returned CHANGES-REQUIRED on 2026-09-27 and was NOT revised, because the owner stopped track planning ('no more track planning only code execution'). The region-scale charter here is unreviewed.
execution_note: Execution is pilot-first outside this plan. The rule engine landed as bd75855d (warehouse/plant_suitability, dark). Wiring as a serving lane (three Vegetation toggles, which retire the botanical UI rows) follows the owner decisions of 2026-09-28. Serving waits on the owner's go to stage and pin the release.

Q1_ssurgo.question: Six v0 axes and three habitat qualifiers need SSURGO survey properties the soil lane does not supply. Hard dependency, or interim serve?
Q1_ssurgo.default: hard dependency on the soil track's SSURGO survey-properties follow-up (DESIGN section 4, F1); everything else ships dark
Q1_ssurgo.alternative: interim v1 with those axes unknown plus fail-closed wetland/habitat rules
Q1_ssurgo.reversal_cost: interim: one rebuild + label change; hard dependency: calendar delay only

Q2_cold_statistic.question: Cold axis: PHZM mean annual extreme minimum, or record minimum from a reanalysis base field?
Q2_cold_statistic.default: PHZM 2023 mean annual extreme minimum (v0 sensitivity run cold_uses_mean_annual_extreme_minimum, strictly more lenient)
Q2_cold_statistic.alternative: record minimum from the 0.1 deg reanalysis frost-free base field (v0 primary)

Q3_frost_free_source.question: Frost-free base field source and spend?
Q3_frost_free_source.default: Open-Meteo ERA5-Land 0.1 deg daily minimum 1991-2020; ~5.9M weighted calls (~7,570 boxes x 783) at the O10 conservative weight; over one month's 5,000,000 paid cap, split across >= 2 months, metered
alternatives: CDS ERA5-Land (no Open-Meteo spend; volume and terms not checked)
0.25 deg transform over meteorology-* after config-driven G7 (no new spend; coarser; waits)

Q4_verified_access.question: Who is 'verified' besides aevani.com affiliates?
Q4_verified_access.default: emailVerified AND (email domain aevani.com OR role expert/admin); no self-serve flow in v1

planning_arithmetic.wa_or_id_cells_estimate: ~0.76M = (184,827 + 254,806 + 216,443 km2 total area) / ~0.868 km2 per 0.01 deg cell at 45.5 N; the build reports the real count
